Product at Brex

 

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.

What you’ll do

 

Travel is one of the most complex—and stressful—areas of company spend. Growing companies must keep bookings moving, travelers supported, policies enforced, payments working, and expenses organized after every trip.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own and scale Brex Travel, our integrated travel experience. You will build across discovery, booking, trip organization, group travel, servicing, payments, and reconciliation—connecting every stage to Brex Card and Expense Management.

You will turn travel technology, inventory, and servicing partners into a cohesive Brex product. Across Engineering, Design, Operations, Partnerships, and GTM, you will drive adoption, bookings, volume, and reliability while using AI to reduce traveler and administrator effort.

Where you’ll work

 

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

 

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for the Brex Travel experience.
  • Build the journey across discovery, booking, trip organization, group travel, servicing, payments, and reconciliation.
  • Connect Travel with Brex Card and Expense Management so booking context flows through payment and accounting.
  • Turn partner technology, inventory, and servicing capabilities into a differentiated Brex product.
  • Own adoption, repeat usage, bookings, travel volume, conversion, and reliability.
  • Improve payment, change, disruption, and support workflows for travelers and administrators.
  • Use AI across planning, booking, trip management, servicing, and reconciliation to remove work.
  • Align Engineering, Design, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success around outcomes.

Requirements

 

  • A track record of owning and growing an end-to-end product.
  • Experience in travel, online booking, marketplaces, or another operationally complex domain.
  • Strong customer judgment alongside fluency in backend systems and operations.
  • Experience building on partner, platform, inventory, or servicing infrastructure.
  • Quantitative ownership of adoption, bookings, volume, conversion, or comparable marketplace metrics.
  • Fluency in servicing, payments, reconciliation, reliability, and exception handling.
  • Practical judgment about how AI can reduce customer and operational effort.
  • Travel product experience is strongly preferred; adjacent marketplace, payments, booking, or complex consumer-product experience can translate.

Compensation

 

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. title: Commercial Account Executive
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As a Commercial Account Executive, you’ll fuel Brex’s growth by winning net-new revenue from small to mid-sized businesses. In this high-volume, fast-paced role, you’ll prospect, build strong partnerships, and close deals by showing the unmatched value of Brex’s all-in-one Financial Operating System—Corporate Card, Expense Management, and Travel.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our Brex offices — San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, or Salt Lake City. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Own the end-to-end sales process from outbound prospecting to discovery, product demos, and closing deals.
  • Pipeline Generation & Management: Consistently source and qualify leads to maintain a strong, reliable pipeline.
  • Value-Based Selling: Clearly communicate ROI and business value by understanding each prospect's goals and aligning Brex’s solutions to their needs.
  • Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Build trust through insight and service, helping prospects navigate challenges and unlock growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Development, Product, and Underwriting to create a smooth and impactful buyer experience.

Requirements

  • 1+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a high-volume or new business-focused role
  • A high-performing SDR/BDR background with a strong track record of sourcing and qualifying opportunities due to high self-prospecting requirements in role
  • Strong ability to communicate value and ROI to small or mid-sized business stakeholders
  • Consistent quota attainment and a history of top-tier performance
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with a focus on results and customer impact

Bonus points

  • Familiarity selling financial software (Expense Management, ERP, AP Automation, T&E, Accounting Software, Banking, etc.)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.

What you’ll do

Card is a core Brex revenue engine. As Staff Product Manager, you will own the strategy for operational spend, finding portfolio-level opportunities across infrastructure, product, and customer workflows that move more critical spend onto Brex.

You will shape intelligent purchasing-card experiences for critical vendors and operational workflows. Your scope spans issuance, lifecycle, authorizations, controls, servicing, and economics—connecting payment fundamentals to differentiated customer experiences.

This scaled-growth role has direct commercial impact. You will align Card Infrastructure, Spend Provisioning, and customer-facing teams to grow card volume and recurring revenue while improving authorization performance, reliability, and customer trust.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Own the card-program strategy for operational spend.
  • Find portfolio-level opportunities to grow card volume, share of wallet, and recurring revenue.
  • Build purchasing-card experiences for critical-vendor and operational-spend workflows.
  • Connect issuance, authorizations, controls, servicing, and economics into one strategy.
  • Use AI to monitor program health, anticipate issues, prevent avoidable declines, and automate routine servicing.
  • Align Card Infrastructure, Spend Provisioning, Risk, Operations, Engineering, Design, and GTM on cross-stack execution.
  • Grow the portfolio without compromising authorization performance, reliability, economics, or trust.
  • Own card volume, recurring revenue, authorization performance, reliability, and workflow adoption.

Requirements

  • A track record of growing a scaled product, revenue portfolio, marketplace, or financial system.
  • Exceptional quantitative judgment across cohort, portfolio, behavioral, and economic metrics.
  • Material impact on payment volume, transactions, revenue, balances, or another scaled metric.
  • Strong systems thinking across infrastructure, operations, economics, and customer experience.
  • Concrete judgment about how AI can improve workflows and system performance.
  • Ability to lead multiple workstreams without reducing strategy to a feature roadmap.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and influence across technical, operational, risk, and commercial teams.
  • Card or payments experience is valuable; strong scaled-growth experience in an adjacent financial product can substitute.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
